text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Acting Prime Minister Sheikh Sabah al-Ahmad al-Sabah receives message from Russian premier Viktor Chernomyrdin.
- Arab human rights body hails Kuwait's steps to protect the rights of its citizens.
- Kuwait's top judge clears prosecutors. The Justice Ministry is said to have asked the Supreme Judicial Council to inspect possible law violations that allegedly involved four prosecutors.
- Kuwait's ambassador to Lebanon says Beirut not complying with a Kuwait-Lebanese trade accord.
- The Palestinian Authority thanks Kuwait for extending an 11-million-dinar ($36.4 million) development loan.
- Bulgaria's President Petar Stoyanov leaves Kuwait after a three-day official visit.
- Ministry of Trade and Industry prepares a bill that would increase the minimum capital for establishing a local insurance firm to five million dinars from 150,000.
- Rally to revise salaries of university professors.
